title: 防御者的窗口：OpenAI 如何强化网络安全防御
summary: 本文探讨了人工智能如何同时改变攻击者和防御者的网络安全格局。OpenAI 作为领先的 AI 公司，正积极加强自身防御体系，以应对 AI 带来的新型威胁。文章指出，AI 的双刃剑效应要求安全团队必须采用新的策略和技术。OpenAI 分享了其防御实践，包括利用 AI 进行威胁检测、自动化响应和持续监控，并强调了主动防御的重要性。同时，文章为安全团队提供了可操作的建议，如部署 AI 驱动的安全工具、加强员工培训、建立跨部门协作机制，以及保持对新兴威胁的警惕。核心观点是，在 AI 时代，防御者必须利用 AI 来增强自身能力，同时理解攻击者如何利用 AI，从而在动态对抗中占据主动。文章还提到了“防御者的窗口”这一概念，指防御者需要抓住 AI 带来的机遇窗口，快速适应和进化，否则将面临更大风险。整体上，这是一份面向网络安全专业人士的指导性内容，旨在帮助组织在 AI 驱动的安全环境中构建韧性。
summary_en: This article explores how AI is reshaping the cybersecurity landscape for both attackers and defenders. OpenAI, as a leading AI company, is actively strengthening its own defenses to address new threats posed by AI. The article highlights the dual-edged nature of AI, requiring security teams to adopt new strategies and technologies. OpenAI shares its defense practices, including using AI for threat detection, automated response, and continuous monitoring, emphasizing the importance of proactive defense. It also provides actionable recommendations for security teams, such as deploying AI-driven security tools, enhancing employee training, fostering cross-departmental collaboration, and maintaining vigilance against emerging threats. The core message is that in the AI era, defenders must leverage AI to augment their capabilities while understanding how attackers exploit AI, thereby gaining an advantage in dynamic confrontation. The article also introduces the concept of the 'defender's window,' referring to the opportunity for defenders to quickly adapt and evolve using AI, or face greater risks. Overall, it serves as a guide for cybersecurity professionals to build resilience in an AI-driven security environment.
